guards: Pins a known escape so the number cannot drift into a promise. M1 rests on fourteen ClinicalFactKeywords, so a real clinical claim phrased without one - reduced left ventricular function in words rather than an ejection fraction - ships uncited, and this case says so out loud beside the 100% reading. Widening the keyword list turns it red on purpose: the escape count then has to be restated deliberately rather than improving silently, and nobody can read 'M1 100%' as 'no uncited claim can ship'.

answer.intent: The chart carries a medication and no labs; the draft cites the medication and then asserts reduced left ventricular function in words, with no citation and no ClinicalFactKeywords term in the line. Asserts that line ships.

problems.display: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
